title: Alliance Digital Strategy
claim_or_role: Explicitly places inference AI at the tactical edge inside a larger architecture of data sharing resilient networks interoperability human-machine collaboration and decision superiority.
caveat: High-level alliance strategy and desired architecture; not evidence that all capabilities are fielded or equally mature.

title: NATO's Digital Transformation Implementation Strategy 2.0
claim_or_role: Shows the 2026 implementation framework tying digital transformation to people processes technology interoperability security and operational superiority.
caveat: Strategic roadmap rather than independent evaluation of battlefield effectiveness.

title: Data Strategy for the Alliance
claim_or_role: Frames data as a strategic asset and establishes a secure collaborative data-sharing ecosystem supporting AI and machine learning while retaining allied control.
caveat: Public strategy omits classified implementation detail and performance.

title: Summary of NATO's Revised Artificial Intelligence Strategy
claim_or_role: Identifies responsible use interoperability testing AI-enabled information threats adversarial AI and the need to protect AI technologies and innovation capacity.
caveat: Alliance goals rather than proof of implementation; public summary omits classified details.

title: Artificial Intelligence Strategy for the Department of War
claim_or_role: Current U.S. institutional direction toward an AI-first force including agentic battle management decision support simulation experimentation and rapid iteration.
caveat: Political and aspirational document; program names and timelines do not demonstrate operational success.

title: DOD Releases AI Adoption Strategy
claim_or_role: Defines enduring decision advantage goals including battlespace awareness adaptive planning resilient sustainment and interoperable data/AI infrastructure.
caveat: Strategy framing from 2023; subsequent administrations and organizations may modify priorities.

title: DOD Adopts 5 Principles of Artificial Intelligence Ethics
claim_or_role: Provides the responsible equitable traceable reliable and governable principles including testing assurance understanding and the ability to disengage systems exhibiting unintended behavior.
caveat: Normative principles do not prove compliance or sufficient assurance in real operations.

title: Responsible Artificial Intelligence Strategy and Implementation Pathway
claim_or_role: Connects responsible AI to trust lifecycle risk governance testing accountability operational agility and scalable adoption.
caveat: Implementation framework; the date embedded in the hosted filename differs from the original 2022 strategy issuance.

title: CDAO Releases Responsible AI Toolkit for Ensuring Alignment With RAI Best Practices
claim_or_role: Shows a concrete assessment toolkit intended to operationalize AI ethical principles and lifecycle risk practices.
caveat: Tool availability does not establish adoption quality or combat validity.

author_or_institution: U.S. Department of State and Department of Defense
title: Political Declaration on Responsible Military Use of Artificial Intelligence and Autonomy
claim_or_role: Supports human responsibility training auditability and measures to mitigate automation bias in high-consequence military AI use.
caveat: Voluntary international political commitment; implementation varies by state.

title: MCDP 6 Command and Control
claim_or_role: Classic command-and-control theory emphasizing uncertainty time timely information decentralized decision-making and acting faster than an adversary without equating speed with omniscience.
caveat: Doctrine is conceptual and predates modern machine learning; used for durable C2 theory rather than AI claims.

title: ADP 6-0 Mission Command
claim_or_role: Defines mission command around decentralized execution shared understanding commander's intent disciplined initiative trust and risk acceptance.
caveat: 2019 doctrine; later publications may refine terminology while preserving core principles.

title: Doctrine Smart Book August 2025
claim_or_role: Confirms continued Army emphasis on command and control authority responsibility feedback communication decentralized execution and mission command principles.
caveat: Summary document rather than full doctrinal treatment.

title: Joint Publications 2-0 Intelligence Series
claim_or_role: Provides the doctrinal foundation for joint intelligence products services assessments and support to operations.
caveat: Public index offers limited detail without controlled-access doctrine materials.

title: FM 6-0 Commander and Staff Organization and Operations Chapter 11 Military Deception
claim_or_role: Treats deception as deliberate manipulation of adversary decision-making and distinguishes ambiguity-increasing and ambiguity-decreasing effects.
caveat: Historical version of doctrine; operational details are not reproduced in the manuscript.

title: Combined Arms Center releases new Army-specific military deception doctrine
claim_or_role: Shows military deception framed as altering adversary decision-making and battlefield calculus within explicit authorities.
caveat: Announcement rather than full doctrine; manuscript stays at conceptual level.

title: A Layered Approach to Active Protection
claim_or_role: Recent public argument that deception attacks adversary hypotheses and can create uncertainty before action.
caveat: Professional military analysis rather than official doctrine; no tactical prescriptions are carried into the book.

author_or_institution: CIA Center for the Study of Intelligence
title: Intelligence Officer's Bookshelf: Operation Fortitude review
claim_or_role: Supports Fortitude as a historical case of coordinated deception exploiting an adversary's intelligence process and prior beliefs.
caveat: Book review and retrospective history; details are used cautiously and corroborated conceptually rather than treated as a complete operational record.

title: Human-Machine Integration in the U.S. Army
claim_or_role: Finds military human-machine integration constrained by trust operational security policy and the need for education testing iteration and sociotechnical adaptation.
caveat: RAND analysis based on assumptions and interviews; does not predict a single future force design.

title: Understanding the Limits of Artificial Intelligence for Warfighters: Volume 1 Summary
claim_or_role: Provides a counterweight to acceleration narratives by examining where AI methods can fail or add little value across warfighting applications.
caveat: Topic page links the report family; use the underlying RAND reports for detailed claims.

author_or_institution: Center for Strategic and International Studies
title: Agentic Warfare and the Future of Military Operations: Rethinking the Napoleonic Staff
claim_or_role: Explores how agentic AI could reshape military staff structures and compress planning and assessment cycles.
caveat: Forward-looking policy analysis; claims about future staff compression are scenarios rather than measured outcomes.

title: Cognitive Warfare and Organizational Design: Leveraging AI to Reshape Military Decisionmaking
claim_or_role: Current professional argument that AI integration changes organizational design and decision processes rather than merely adding tools to legacy staffs.
caveat: Professional analysis and advocacy; not official doctrine or controlled experiment.

title: Finding Deepfakes: A Tabletop Exercise About AI Decisionmaking and Algorithmic Performance
claim_or_role: Shows how algorithmic limitations can degrade trust introduce uncertainty and complicate decisions in an information-manipulation scenario.
caveat: Tabletop exercise with bounded scenario; not evidence of field performance.

title: Defense Command and Control: Further Progress Hinges on Establishing a Comprehensive Framework
claim_or_role: Finds fragmented CJADC2 efforts and cross-organizational problems despite the objective of faster real-time information sharing and analysis.
caveat: Audit captures a 2025 snapshot and public evidence; classified progress may differ.

title: Weapon Systems Testing: DOD Needs to Update Policies to Better Support Modernization Efforts
claim_or_role: Finds gaps in iterative testing policy and highlights digital engineering user feedback and early testing as relevant to complex software-driven systems.
caveat: Broad weapon-system testing report not AI-specific; used for institutional testing capacity and iteration.

title: Weapon Systems Testing: Reorganization of DOD's Office of the Director Operational Test and Evaluation
claim_or_role: Documents reduced public-sector test oversight capacity and risks of undocumented operational shortfalls when expertise and staffing decline.
caveat: Focuses organizational capacity not AI in particular; current as of June 2026.

author_or_institution: National Institute of Standards and Technology
title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile
claim_or_role: Provides lifecycle risk-management concepts for evaluation documentation monitoring incident handling and trustworthiness.
caveat: Voluntary cross-sector framework not military doctrine.

title: Strategic Military Artificial Intelligence
claim_or_role: Recommends data policy appropriate testing iterative development education trust calibration and organizational design for military AI adoption.
caveat: Analytical recommendations; publication sponsorship and assumptions should be considered.

author_or_institution: Center for Strategic and International Studies
title: Algorithmic Stability: How AI Could Shape the Future of Deterrence
claim_or_role: Explores how AI-enabled decision layers may create new escalation and stability dynamics and how uncertainty about an adversary's AI changes crisis choices.
caveat: Wargame-derived insights are illustrative rather than predictive and include operational hypotheticals not reproduced here.

author_or_institution: Center for Strategic and International Studies
title: AI and Grand Strategy: The Case for Restraint
claim_or_role: Provides a counterargument to simple AI-arms-race narratives and supports treating strategic choices institutions and restraint as independent variables.
caveat: Argumentative policy essay; used as counterpoint rather than consensus.

author_or_institution: Center for Strategic and International Studies
title: How Russia Is Reshaping Command and Control for AI-Enabled Warfare
claim_or_role: Contemporary case study of wartime pressure reshaping C2 software and AI adoption rather than technology arriving into a static organization.
caveat: Open-source analysis of a live conflict with unavoidable uncertainty and incomplete access.

author_or_institution: Center for Strategic and International Studies
title: Defining Autonomy: Why Software Not Drones Will Decide the Next War
claim_or_role: Argues that autonomy should be understood at the system and software decision layer rather than only at the physical platform.
caveat: Policy proposal published during active regulatory change; not settled law or doctrine.

title: Remarks on the State of AI in the Department of Defense
claim_or_role: States the decision-advantage rationale for AI and describes CJADC2 as a set of concepts technologies policies and talent rather than one platform.
caveat: Leadership speech is advocacy and institutional messaging rather than independent measurement.

title: Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office Hosts Global Information Dominance Experiments
claim_or_role: Documents joint experiments using data analytics and AI to inform all-domain command-and-control approaches.
caveat: Program announcement offers limited public performance evidence.
